title: Longest Palindromic Substring
statement_short: Given a string s, return the longest palindromic substring in s.
constraints: 1 <= s.length <= 1000, s consists of only digits and English letters
hint: String length up to 1000 permits checking center expansion for odd and even palindrome lengths.
why_not: Right: Two Pointers expands outward from each character center (odd and even lengths) in O(n^2) time and O(1) space. Not 2D DP: 2D DP stores boolean palindrome states dp[i][j] in O(n^2) time but consumes O(n^2) auxiliary memory. Not Sliding Window: Palindromes expand symmetrically from centers rather than maintaining a monotonic window. Not HashMap / Hash Set: Hash sets check substring existence but do not verify symmetrical palindrome ordering.
